newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian March preliminary CPI due on March 20, 21.
newsitem.headline: Italian March preliminary CPI due on March 20, 21.

text.p: Italy's national statistics office ISTAT said on Friday that preliminary data on March consumer price index (CPI) inflation will be published by eleven Italian cities on March 20 and March 21 around 1630 GMT.
On March 20, Turin, Milan, Genoa, Venice, Trieste, Bologna and Perugia will report their preliminary March data.
On March 21, Florence, Naples, Bari and Palmero will report their March CPI figures.
ISTAT will report official national March CPI data on April 7.
